correctness.rationale: The conditional Gaussian convolution gives the exact second and fourth moments and the lagged squared covariance by Isserlis identity. Stationary filtered-telegraph generator identities establish E[Z²]=κ/(κ+λ), the integral F has derivative -4κ∫_0^h u exp[-2κ(h-u)-2λu]du<0 for all h>0, and positivity of D_± bounds 0<λ<κ(3/K-1). Together these prove the necessary-and-sufficient open observable region and unique inversion. An independently formulated two-state generator and finite-time second-moment quadrature reproduces 600 cases; those finite tests do not replace the universal proof. No singularity at λ=κ, where the integral is continuous.

value.rationale: The same full two-point position covariance V exp(-κh) arises for infinitely many λ and diffusivity contrasts. The pair of fourth-order measurements (stationary excess kurtosis and one lagged squared-position covariance) recovers exactly these otherwise hidden parameters with sharp strict compatibility inequalities. This solves a natural model-identifiability and falsification problem for switching thermal environments, not a mere arbitrary statistic or incremental table computation. Stability with noisy data is intentionally not claimed.
